<div class="card-body">
'''Death Star: Trash Compactor''' is a [[Light]] [[Location]] ([[Site]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">デス・スター：ゴミ圧縮装置</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">人員がいなくても配備できる。ここを支配していれば、フォース消耗に＋１。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-125o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Death Star: Trash Compactor.

'''Light Side:''' May deploy even if there are no personnel. If you control here, add 1 to the Force drain.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese deploys even with no personnel (English: without presence) and adds 1 to the Force drain (English: Force drain +1 here).
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Death Star: Trash Compactor]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 98. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
